chunks: 4 - He said: Abul Husayn Muhammad ibn al-Muzaffar al-Bazzaz reported to me, saying: Abu Abdillah Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Hasani narrated to us, saying: Idris ibn Ziyad al-Kafarthuthi narrated to us, saying: Hannan ibn Sudair narrated to us, from Sudaif al-Makki, who said: Muhammad ibn Ali, peace be upon them both — and I have never seen any follower of Muhammad who equals him — narrated to me, saying: Jabir ibn Abdillah al-Ansari narrated to me, saying:

The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and his family, made an announcement among the Muhajirun and the Ansar, so they assembled with their weapons. The Prophet climbed the pulpit, praised Allah and expressed gratitude to Him, then said: 'O assembly of Muslims, whoever hates us, the Ahlul Bayt, Allah shall resurrect him on the Day of Resurrection as a Jew.'

Jabir said: I stood up and said: 'O Messenger of Allah, even if he testified that there is no god but Allah, and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah?' He said: 'Even if he testified that there is no god but Allah, that merely protected him from his blood being spilled, or from paying the jizyah submissively while being humiliated.'

Then he said: 'Whoever hates us, the Ahlul Bayt, Allah shall resurrect him as a Jew. If he meets the Dajjal, he would be with him; and if he does not meet him, he would be raised in his grave and believe in him. Indeed, my Lord presented my Ummah before me in clay, and taught me their names as He taught Adam all the names. Then the bearers of standards passed by me, and I sought forgiveness for Ali and his followers.'

Hannan ibn Sudair said: I presented this hadith before Abu Abdillah Ja'far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon them both, and he said to me: 'Did you yourself hear this from Sudaif?' I said: 'It is now the seventh night since I heard it from him.' He said: 'Indeed, I never thought that this narration ever escaped the lips of my father to anyone.'

key_terms.أَهْلَ البَيْتِ: Ahlul Bayt — the household of the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW), specifically referring to the Prophet, Ali, Fatima, Hasan, and Husayn and the Imams from their progeny
key_terms.الأَنْصَار: The Ansar — the Muslim residents of Medina who supported the Prophet
key_terms.الجِزْيَة: The jizyah — a tax paid by non-Muslims living under Islamic governance
key_terms.الدَّجَّالَ: The Dajjal — the false messiah (Antichrist) who will appear near the end of times as a great trial for believers
key_terms.المُهَاجِرِينَ: The Muhajirun — the early Muslims who emigrated from Mecca to Medina
key_terms.شِيعَتِهِ: His Shia — the followers and partisans of Imam Ali (AS)

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) say about those who hate the Ahlul Bayt?
ai.summary: This hadith, narrated through a chain reaching the companion Jabir ibn Abdillah al-Ansari, records the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) publicly proclaiming from the pulpit in Medina before the assembled Muhajirun and Ansar that whoever harbors hatred for the Ahlul Bayt will be resurrected on the Day of Judgment as a Jew — even if he outwardly professed the shahada. The Prophet further stated that such a person would become a follower of the Dajjal. He also revealed that Allah showed him the entire Ummah in primordial clay and that he specifically prayed for Ali and his followers. Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq (AS) confirmed the hadith’s authenticity while expressing surprise that his father (Imam al-Baqir) had shared it.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 4. He said: Abul Husayn Muhammad ibn al-Mudhaffer al-Bazzaz reported to me from Abu Abdillah Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Hasani, who reported from Idris ibn Ziyad al-Kafrsosi, who reported from Hannan ibn Sudair, from Sudaif al-Makki who reported from Muhammad ibn ‘Ali, peace be upon hm (commenting that I have not seen any believer of Muhammad to match his excellence) who reported from Jabir ibn Abdillah al-Ansari, who said:

Once, the Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, caused an announcement to be made among the Muhajir and Ansar, so they assembled with their weapons. The Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, climbed the pulpit, praised Allah and expressed his gratitude to Him. Then he said: "O Muslims, whoever hates us, the Ahlul Bayt, Allah shall resurrect him on the day of Judgement as a follower of Judaism."

Jabir said: I stood up and asked: "O messenger of Allah, will it happen even if I testify that there is no god but Allah, and that Muhammad is the messenger of Allah?" He said: "If he testified that there is no god but Allah, that saved him from his blood being spilled and from paying the tax submissively and with humility."

Then the Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny said: "Whoever hates us, the Ahlul Bayt, Allah shall resurrect him, as a follower of Judaism on the Day of Judgement, and if he ever met Dajjal, he would be his partisan. And, even if he did not meet him (i.e. Dajjal), he would be resurrected in his grave, so that he believes in him (i.e. Dajjal). Surely, Allah made the whole of my Ummah appear before me while still in dust, and taught me their names, the way he taught all the names to Adam. So, standard bearers passed by me and I prayed for forgiveness, in favour of ‘Ali and his followers.

Hannan ibn Sudair said: I narrated this Tradition before Abu Abdillah Ja’far ibnMuhammad, peace be upon him, and he said: "Did you yourself hear this from Sudaif?" He said: "It is now seventh night since I heard from him." He (i.e. Abu Abdillah) said: "I never thought that this narration ever escaped the lips of my father to anyone."
